name: iDLC
desc: Explicit biology/technical disentanglement plus optimal-transport-regularised adversarial alignment guided by mutual-nearest-neighbour pairs (abstract read; full text not read).
why: Closest to W1/OT + adversarial on the same task; the literature track saw it (evidence.md gap search: 'a method, not a controlled comparison; not cited').

name: scStarCorrect
desc: StarGAN-based model: batch-conditioned VAE plus a domain-aware discriminator that aligns every batch to one fixed reference batch (one-way correction) (abstract read).
why: Same reference-anchored design as the reference critic here.

name: Beaconet
desc: Aligns the global distribution of each batch with an adversarial correction network in the original gene space, with no reference batch; compared with 13 methods (abstract read).

name: Portal
desc: Unified adversarial domain-translation framework for atlas-level integration, scaling to millions of cells (abstract read).

name: AIF (Adversarial Information Factorization)
cite: Monnier, Cournede. PLoS Comput Biol 2024;20:e1011880. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011880
desc: Adversarial batch-effect correction that needs no cell-type labels or normalisation choice (abstract read).
why: Adversarial method of the same class as the discriminator arm.

name: ABC (Autoencoder-based Batch Correction)
cite: Danino ... Sharan (3 authors). Bioinform Adv 2023;4:vbad186. doi:10.1093/bioadv/vbad186
desc: Semi-supervised autoencoder with cell-type classifier branches and adversarial batch alignment (abstract read).
why: Adversarial method of the same class as the discriminator arm.

name: IMGG
cite: Wang ... Song (7 authors). Int J Mol Sci 2022;23:2082. doi:10.3390/ijms23042082
desc: GAN plus connected graphs to remove batch differences across several datasets (abstract read). Shares two authors (X. Wang, C. Zhang) with IMAAE, whose Methods reuse IMGG's cross-batch connected graph (IMAAE text names IMGG 3 times).
why: Sibling of IMAAE, already in the text.

name: scFLASH
cite: Zhou ... Wu (8 authors). CSIAM Trans Life Sci 2026;2:177-202. doi:10.4208/csiam-ls.so-2025-0025
desc: Conditional VAE with adversarial training and a penalised condition classifier for multi-batch, multi-condition data (abstract read).

name: SCIDRL
cite: Guo ... Zhang (5 authors). Nucleic Acids Res 2021 (50:e8). doi:10.1093/nar/gkab978
desc: Domain-adaptation-based disentangled representation learning for batch-invariant embeddings; the abstract does not say adversarial (abstract read).

name: SIDA
desc: Supervised integration through domain adaptation guided by cell-type annotations (abstract read).

name: scNym
desc: Semi-supervised adversarial network that transfers cell-identity labels across experiments despite technical differences (abstract read); annotation, not embedding integration.

name: Supervised adversarial alignment
desc: Domain-adversarial network learning a representation predictive of cell type but not of batch (abstract read).

name: MAGAN
desc: Manifold-Aligning GAN aligning scRNA-seq with mass-cytometry measurements (abstract read).
why: GAN alignment from the SAUCIE group.

name: SCOT
cite: Demetci ... Singh (5 authors). J Comput Biol 2022;29:3-18. doi:10.1089/cmb.2021.0446
desc: Gromov-Wasserstein optimal-transport alignment of single-cell multi-omics datasets without correspondence (abstract read); multi-omics, not batch correction.

name: scConfluence
cite: Samaran ... Cantini (3 authors). Nat Commun 2024;15:7762. doi:10.1038/s41467-024-51382-x
desc: Diagonal integration combining uncoupled autoencoders with regularised inverse optimal transport (abstract read); multimodal.

name: Pareto front on scVI
cite: Li ... Wei (4 authors). BMC Bioinformatics 2022;23:460. doi:10.1186/s12859-022-05003-3
desc: Learns the whole trade-off curve between biological conservation and batch removal on scVI with Pareto multi-task learning; measures batch effect with MINE versus MMD (abstract read).
why: Matches Reviewer 2's request for a Pareto-front analysis and the 'trade-off area' of P1.

name: stVAE
desc: Conditional VAE, Y-autoencoder and adversarial feature decomposition for harmonisation of RNA-seq data (abstract read).

name: GLUE
desc: Graph-linked unified embedding for multi-omics integration that models regulatory interactions across omics layers explicitly (abstract read; the abstract does not say adversarial). The sysVI paper calls GLUE 'a well-established adversarial model' (sysVI text read). Named in Introduction line 151 without a reference.
why: Named in the Introduction; no refs.bib entry.
